name: Silent Chorus
description:
Some arenas have 'Gramophone' devices installed, but end up never using them. During the match with the Left-handed Knight, the Candle Knight extinguished all Arts in the arena simply by raising her hand. Beneath the darkened sky, only her candlelight continued to shine brightly. 
<'Gramophone'>Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, deals Arts damage to enemies and heals allies.
